Scorched 
a) Burned or dried by heat 
b) Shiny and sparkling 
c) Trembling with fear 
d) Feeling indifferent 
 
Slag 
a) Waste material left after metal is smelted 
b) A shimmering light 
c) A protective covering 
d) A graceful movement
